title: The Vision of the New Temple
description: In the 25th year after the exile, the prophet Ezekiel receives a vision in which he is brought to the land of Israel and up on a high mountain. A man who looks like bronze, with a measuring rod in his hand, leads him through a future temple complex and measures everything precisely: the gates facing east, north, and south with guardrooms and vestibules, the outer and inner courts, the rooms where sacrifices are slaughtered, the priests' chambers, the temple hall itself with the Most Holy Place, side chambers with carved cherubim and palm trees, and the altar. Finally, the wall around the entire area is measured, which will separate the holy from the common.
